claim: Monte Carlo sampling of probabilistic Bayesian neural network weights is effective in propagating uncertainty in BNN-integrated physics-informed machine learning architectures.
falsifier: One could compare uncertainty estimates from a BNN-integrated PIML model with and without Monte Carlo sampling of weights, measuring calibration or coverage.

exclusions: limited to the reported system, task, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished

title: Monte Carlo sampling–uncertainty propagation mechanism
